description: This file defines an internal interface 'ILogConsistencyProtocolGateway' within the namespace 'Orleans.SystemTargetInterfaces'. It serves as a relay for forwarding protocol messages between clusters in an Orleans-based system, specifically related to log consistency protocol. The interface inherits from 'ISystemTarget' and declares a single asynchronous method 'RelayMessage' that accepts a grain identifier and a protocol message payload, returning a task encapsulating the protocol message.

methods.name: RelayMessage
methods.description: An asynchronous method that forwards a protocol message to the appropriate cluster component, returning a protocol message as response.
